mechanism: Cross-sectional 7-day trailing return momentum, long-only, top-quintile weekly selection within a live-eligible, liquidity-filtered universe. LIGHTWEIGHT LIVE RECONSTRUCTION of W1's M1 finding -- NOT a replication. See CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_PIT_V1 (configs/live_alpha_registry.yaml, still DATA_BLOCKED, untouched) for the true original spec (PIT 312-symbol universe, data_v2/normalized).
source_report: reports/edge_discovery/alpha_hunt_2026-08-30/w1_cross_sectional/REPORT.md rank 1 (M1), 'Detail on the two most promising candidates' section 1
reconstruction_rationale: The original W1 finding was measured on a PIT 312-symbol universe (data_v2/normalized/perp_ohlcv, worktree futur-data-v2, one-off backfill, no confirmed continuous live update). That data is unavailable to this live system -- see CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_PIT_V1 which stays DATA_BLOCKED. Per the mission's own cost/benefit instruction, this alpha is instead built from the minimal live-only inputs the mechanism actually needs: price, 7d trailing return, daily $-volume/liquidity, live listing eligibility, a PIT-ish (frozen, live-resolved) universe, and weekly rebalance state -- no L2, no heavy storage.

data_investigation.data_enriched_1h: 50 files under data/enriched/ for the frozen-50 universe. Checked mtimes at freeze time: only 10/50 are fresh (2026-08-31, same day) -- exactly BTC/ETH/BNB/SOL/XRP/DOGE/ADA/AVAX/DOT/LINK, the live 10-symbol paper-trading fleet updated continuously by scripts/run_paper_portfolio_v1.py (futur-paper-v1.service). The other 40/50 files are STALE since 2026-06-29 (>2 months old at freeze time) -- confirmed via `ls -la --time-style=full-iso`, no systemd service or timer touches data/enriched (scripts/backfill_enriched_from_binance.py exists but is a manual/on-demand script, not scheduled). REJECTED as this alpha's data source: a cross-sectional rank needs the WHOLE eligible universe's recent returns -- ranking 40/50 symbols on 2-month-old closes would silently corrupt the ranking, not just shrink the sample. Also note (per mission brief): this dataset's taker_buy_* columns are a known fake placeholder (taker_buy_quote == quote_asset_volume/2 exactly) -- irrelevant here since this alpha never touches taker_buy_* at all, but flagged since data/enriched was investigated.
data_investigation.data_v2_instrument_master: The ORIGINAL spec's universe source (312-symbol PIT panel, data_v2/instruments/instrument_master.parquet). DATA_BLOCKED per CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_PIT_V1 -- lives only in the separate futur-data-v2 worktree, no continuous live update confirmed. Not used here; that data gap is exactly why this is a separate, RECONSTRUCTED alpha_id rather than an edit to CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_PIT_V1.
data_investigation.derivatives_raw_mark_price: data/derivatives_raw/ has LIVE mark_price for the frozen-50 universe (futur-derivatives.service, REST poll ~every 5 minutes, confirmed running at freeze time) but is OI/funding/mark-price data, NOT real kline trading volume. Cannot support the liquidity filter (trailing-30d median quote-volume >= $1M) this mechanism requires. Considered and rejected as the primary price/volume source (mark_price could substitute for close in principle, but there is no real-volume companion field in this store).
data_investigation.chosen_source: Binance USDM futures public REST /fapi/v1/klines (interval=1d), no API key required -- the same endpoint already used elsewhere in this repo (scripts/backfill_enriched_from_binance.py; the sibling exchangeInfo endpoint is used by src/institutional/data/derivatives_collector/symbol_resolver.py). Polled ON DEMAND inside scripts/run_cross_sectional_momentum_live_shadow.py -- NOT a new persistent daemon or systemd service (explicit instruction to avoid new live infrastructure given ~32GB free disk headroom at the time of this build). Fetched data is cached incrementally into a small local parquet per symbol under reports/live_alpha_lab/CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_LIVE_V1/klines_cache/ -- 3 columns (date, close, quote_volume), a few thousand rows/symbol at most (daily granularity since each symbol's listing date, not 1h/L2) -- explicitly 'pas de gros stockage' per the mission's instruction. Network connectivity to fapi.binance.com verified reachable from this environment at build time (futur-derivatives.service is independently already polling it continuously).

universe.source: configs/portfolio_v1_1_parallel_50.yaml (frozen 50-symbol canonical list -- SAME universe file as LIQ_CASCADE_REPEAT_V1 / SHORT_COVERING_CONTINUATION_V1 / WHALE_LSR_SCREEN_V1, hash-checked at runtime, fail-closed if drifted).
universe.listing_eligibility: src/institutional/data/derivatives_collector/symbol_resolver.py::resolve_universe against LIVE /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo (status=TRADING), reused READ-ONLY -- this is this alpha's substitute for the 312-symbol PIT instrument_master.parquet's 'universe PIT / listing eligibility' role, per the mission's explicit suggestion. At this alpha's actual first run (2026-08-31T21:56:28Z), MKRUSDT's live exchangeInfo status was SETTLING (not TRADING) -- excluded, real status preserved verbatim (never forced to a generic 'DELISTED' label per symbol_resolver.py's own discipline), see _symbol_resolution.json for the exact reason string. This differs from an earlier sibling alpha's docstring note calling MKRUSDT 'delisted, code -4108' -- exchange status can change between checks; each run re-resolves live and never trusts a cached label. PEPEUSDT/RNDRUSDT resolved via KNOWN_RENAMES to 1000PEPEUSDT/RENDERUSDT (both confirmed TRADING at first-run time). 49/50 eligible at first run; the resolution trace is written fresh every run to _symbol_resolution.json (never silent).
universe.deviation_from_source: Source W1 report ranked within a PIT 312-symbol universe (liq>=$1M filter applied WITHIN that larger set, i.e. still a wide cross-section after filtering). This reconstruction ranks within the ~49-symbol frozen-50 set only -- a MUCH smaller, majors/large-established-alt-biased cross-section. HONEST CAVEAT (not hidden): the source report explicitly found the effect is an 'altcoin breadth' phenomenon that lives in 'the broad liquid-altcoin set, not majors or junk' -- majors-only alone was INSIGNIFICANT in the source's own robustness check (t=0.72). The frozen-50 universe sits between the source's 'majors' and 'broad liquid altcoin' subsets -- it may therefore measure a materially WEAKER or even absent version of the effect. This is a real risk to this reconstruction's validity, not a cosmetic detail.

frozen_spec.rebalance_weekday: Monday (pd.Timestamp.weekday()==0) -- ARBITRARY but FIXED anchor; the source report specifies non-overlapping 7-day rebalance periods but does not name a weekday anchor.
frozen_spec.direction: LONG only, hard-enforced in the runner (RuntimeError if any non-LONG row ever appears) -- SHORT_REJECTED (standing project rule) AND matches the source's own finding that the top-quintile long side captures most of the edge (decile table: q4=106.6bps vs q0=8.6bps, 'winners keep winning', not a symmetric long-short spread).
frozen_spec.signal: tret_7d = close[t]/close[t-7]-1, causal, computed on daily USDM futures close prices from live REST klines, reindexed to a gap-free daily calendar before the shift (so lookback=7 rows == 7 calendar days).
frozen_spec.liquidity_filter: trailing 30-day MEDIAN daily quote-asset-volume (USD) >= $1,000,000 -- VERBATIM match to the source report's own filter definition, not an approximation or reconstruction.
frozen_spec.selection: top ceil(0.20 * n_eligible) symbols by tret_7d among the liquidity-eligible cohort at each Monday rebalance. top_fraction=0.20 (quintile) is the SOURCE REPORT'S OWN measured/recommended bucket ('a long-only top-quintile overlay captures most of the edge'), not an independently invented or grid-searched threshold -- the one number in this spec that is genuinely verbatim-sourced rather than reconstructed.
frozen_spec.current_day_handling: the in-progress UTC daily bar (today, not yet closed) is dropped from the panel before any computation -- a rebalance decision never reads a candle that hasn't closed yet.

expected_stats_at_freeze.note: HISTORICAL CONTEXT ONLY from the source report's PIT 312-symbol full-sample measurement -- NOT a forward target for this reconstruction, which uses a materially smaller, majors-biased universe and a different (live REST) data source than what produced these numbers. Same framing discipline as LIQ_CASCADE_FAR_FROM_LOW_V1 / SHORT_COVERING_CONTINUATION_V1's expected_net_bps notes. Do not read forward edge_retention against these figures without re-deriving a universe-appropriate baseline.
expected_stats_at_freeze.cost_model_note: the source's 20bps is a market-neutral LONG-SHORT quintile-spread floor (4 legs: long entry/exit + short entry/exit, 100% turnover assumption). NOT directly applicable to this long-only reconstruction (2 legs: entry+exit only) -- a long-only single-leg cost floor is closer to this repo's other single-name conventions (~10-14bps taker round trip). No net_bps target is claimed for this reconstruction's actual universe/costs -- Mode A here is signal-only, no fills simulated, no cost applied to any row.
